description: Cathay Pacific's founding aircraft. Built as USAAC C-47-DL 41-18385; c/n 4423; sold surplus and registered NC58093 to Roy Farrell in Shanghai in October 1945; became VR-HDB with Cathay Pacific from October 1946; sold to New Guinea Airways as VH-MAL in 1953 and flew for Mandated Airlines and Ansett in Papua New Guinea until 1973; later with Bush Pilots Airways in Queensland; repurchased by Swire and flown home to Hong Kong in 1983 with Adrian Swire on the final leg; transferred to the museum in September 1983 and displayed in original Cathay Pacific livery. Year_built left blank — no sourced construction or acceptance date was found and 41- is an order-year prefix; not a build year
